definition.proposition: At matched training compute, a recurrence is worth r^0.46 unique blocks (r=4: 410M looped ≈ 580M non-looped at a 1B model's training cost). Truncated BPTT lowers the exponent to 0.38 even though val loss falls; loop-level hyper-connections raise it to 0.65. Iso-FLOP deeper non-looped models also win on PPL in looped Mamba-2 (CHASE)
